faq.title: Everything else you might want to know

items.a: One project = one call campaign. A call center working for three clients has three projects in CallScope. A freelancer calling for two clients has two. Pricing is €49 per project per month.

items.q: Do I really get 14 days free?
items.a: Yes, on your first project. No credit card needed. The trial expires automatically after 14 days — no surprise invoice. You only pay once you activate a subscription. A second project requires an active subscription right away.
Yes. Through your Stripe customer portal you can cancel or pause anytime. Access continues until the end of the paid month. No annual contracts, no lock-in.

Everything. Unlimited cold callers, sales reps and sales managers per project. Unlimited calls. Google Sheets sync, HubSpot integration, AI objection detection, custom fields, client reports via share link or PDF, mail reports — all included. No hidden tier system.

Yes. Stripe automatically generates an invoice after each payment, with your VAT number if you provide it. 21% Belgian VAT is calculated automatically. Invoices can be downloaded via the customer portal, and are also emailed.

items.q: Which payment methods do you support?
items.a: Bancontact, card (Visa / Mastercard / Amex), iDEAL, and SEPA debit. All via Stripe. No bank transfers — the system has to automate.

items.q: Does CallScope work for solo freelancers?
items.a: Absolutely. At registration choose "freelance appointment setter" — you automatically get your own call center and you're immediately your own cold caller. One login, all the data, the same €49 per month per project.

items.q: What if I delete my project?
items.a: Your subscription on that project is automatically cancelled. You don't pay anything more. The data is wiped along with it (uploads, calls, appointments, feedback) — so only delete if you really don't need it anymore.

items.q: Does the trial apply to every new project?
items.a: No. One trial per account. Your first project gets 14 days free; from the second project on you have to subscribe right away. This prevents abuse (people creating new projects every 14 days).

items.q: Is my data shared with other customers?
items.a: Never. Each customer only sees their own data. We use Postgres Row-Level Security: even if someone hits the Supabase API directly, they can't see other customers' data. AI analysis happens per project and your notes are never used for model training.

items.q: Is there a discount for multiple projects?
items.a: Not by default. Got 5+ projects and want to discuss? Email arne@halcoservices.be. We're reasonable.

items.q: How do I stop using CallScope?
items.a: Open the customer portal, click "Cancel subscription". Done. No "we'll miss you" emails, no retention attempts.

hubspot.helpSummary: 📖 How do I set up HubSpot for CallScope? (4 steps)

step1.title: 1. Create a contacts list
step1.body: In HubSpot: CRM → Segments (Lists) → Create list → type Contact-based. Add the contacts your team cold-calls for this client. Save and pick it in the dropdown above.

step2.title: 2. Create an "Appointment booked" call outcome
step2.intro: By default HubSpot only has Connected / Busy / No answer / Voicemail / Wrong number. For CallScope we need at least one outcome whose name contains the word "appointment" (or "afspraak" if you use Dutch) — then CallScope automatically recognizes the call as an appointment.
step2.li4: Next to "Track call outcomes" click ✏️ Edit options
step2.li5: Click + Add outcome, name: Appointment booked → Save
step2.note: Optional: also create outcomes "Appointment no-show", "Appointment rescheduled" etc. — anything with "appointment" in the name counts.

step3.title: 3. Log calls during cold-call
step3.body: On a contact page: Log activity → Call → pick the right outcome (e.g. "Appointment booked") → optionally note details in the body → save. The call appears in CallScope after the next sync (manually via Sync now or automatically overnight).

step4.title: 4. Deals + dealstages → automatic outcome detection
step4.body: When the sales rep does the appointment, they create a Deal in HubSpot for the contact and update the dealstage (e.g. Appointment scheduled → Qualified → Closed won). CallScope reads that stage daily and maps it via AI to quote / deal / lost / no-show. The result shows up on the team dashboard and the Appointments page.

hubspot.footer: Ready? Test your setup by logging one call + creating one deal in HubSpot, then click Sync now on the team dashboard. The call should appear within seconds with the correct status.

cc_manager.subtitle: As call center manager you manage projects for your team. In a few minutes your first setup is ready.

1.desc: Pick a name, decide how data comes in (manually or via Google Sheets), and which members will work on it.

2.title: Invite your team members
2.desc: During the project wizard you add cold callers, sales reps and sales managers via their email address. They don't need an account yet — existing users are linked directly, new emails get an invitation mail to create their account.

3.desc: With Google Sheets sync: link a sheet per cold caller on the project settings page. With manual: your callers upload CSV files via the upload page.

4.title: Open your team dashboard
4.desc: Conversion funnel, deal rates and AI insights — automatically computed from your data.
